column1: # seat-model-tiers.tsv — per-seat review-model tier for the gardening panel.
# panel.sh's seat_model_flag reads this to choose a `claude --model` per juror seat
# (and for the decider/appellate decision calls). Columns: <seat>\t<tier>.
# Tiers (Anthropic-only, the models a monk's `claude -p` can reach):
#   opus    inherit the fleet's resolved ceiling model (NO --model passed) — the
#           deepest reasoning; the tiering NEVER routes a seat above this.
#   sonnet  a strong general reviewer; the default for a scoped-rubric seat.
# An unmapped seat defaults to opus (fail-safe: full capability). Rationale and the
# Overridable wholesale via GARDEN_PANEL_SEAT_TIERS, per-tier via
# --- opus: adversarial / security / expert-distilled / deepest architecture ----
# --- sonnet: the default — a strong general reviewer with a scoped rubric -------
